_doc: CENTRAL REGISTRY of known hit categories — the source of truth for sorting/bucketing gem5 hits and viewing them in the dashboard. As we triage hits (writing a diag_*.py + bug .md in a run's diagnostics/), we REGISTER the category here. Each category links to the testsets/builds it SCOPES to (per CLAUDE.md propagation rules: a model/concretization artifact scopes to its testset only; a build behavior scopes to all runs on that build). The per-run diagnostics/buckets/summary.json gives the COUNTS; the dashboard joins those to this registry for labels, verdicts, and colors. Anything not matching a category stays NEW_candidate_pure_bug = the research signal.

checker.label: checker false positive
checker.note: the checker over-counted; not a real gem5 leak

artifact.label: model/concretization artifact
artifact.note: Alloy over-approximation or codegen artifact; not a real leak

new.label: NEW — unexplained
new.note: cleared all disqualifiers, not yet explained — THE research signal

known_pending.label: known cause, verdict pending
known_pending.note: a trace-proven known cause whose count-as-bug verdict is an open DECIDE (e.g. CS-1, CleanupSpec E->M); reported separately, never a target

phases.disqualifier: run first; if matched, the hit is NOT a real leak

check_ld_no_completion.label: check_ld no-completion (over-count)
check_ld_no_completion.description: check_ld flagged an in-window load that never actually completed/obtained data → not a leak.

recon_slf.label: Recon STL/SLF store-forward bypass
recon_slf.description: Store-to-load forwarding bypasses Recon's taint check — a real recon bug (double-gated signature).

constaddr_load.label: constant-address load
constaddr_load.description: Load address is a constant operand (zero-index) → data-taint over-approximation; not an STT/SpecLFB disqualifier.

nonspec_cotransmit.label: SPT non-spec co-transmit (pre-fix model artifact)
nonspec_cotransmit.description: SPT model-generation artifact (fixed by the inaddr-cleanup regen); disqualifier, not a real leak.

rf_clobber.label: rf-clobber (stale reaching-def)
rf_clobber.description: A later writer clobbers the rf source between producer and use → not a genuine speculative dependency.

branch_wrongpath_respec.label: branch wrong-path re-speculation (RAS artifact)
branch_wrongpath_respec.description: gadget retq/loop re-speculation (gem5-spt delays tainted branches to VP) — control-flow/RAS artifact.

vp_squash_race.label: STT/SPT VP↔squash race
vp_squash_race.description: Untaint on resolved-not-committed vs the squash — the one known STT/SPT speculative-window race.

NEW_candidate_pure_bug.label: NEW — unexplained (research signal)
NEW_candidate_pure_bug.description: Hits that cleared ALL disqualifiers and match no known real-bug signature. The set to root-cause.

disq_data_obtained.label: disq_not_obtained
disq_data_obtained.description: check_ld data-obtained gate: an in-window ld transmitter that never obtained its data is not a leak.

disq_setup_block.label: excluded_SETUP
disq_setup_block.description: SETUP exclusion: an offending event that belongs to the harness's own cache-setup block, not to the test.

disq_hpad_text_end.label: excluded_HPAD
disq_hpad_text_end.description: H-PAD (text end): an offending event executed by the harness zero padding past the end of .text.

disq_hpad_rmw_padding.label: UV3_padding|EM_padding
disq_hpad_rmw_padding.description: H-PAD (RMW padding actor): a CleanupSpec UV3 / E->M chain whose actor is the harness padding RMW, not the test's RMW.

disq_speclfb_nonload.label: other:disq_non_load_footprint
disq_speclfb_nonload.description: SpecLFB non-load footprint: an in-window footprint event whose request is not a load is not a SpecLFB leak.

disq_check_ld_rmw_limm.label: check_ld RMW artifact (scores the RMW's leading limm micro-op; delay unit holds the load; RL-10 resolved)
disq_check_ld_rmw_limm.description: check_ld RMW artifact (RL-10): check_ld scores the RMW's leading limm micro-op; ReCon's delay unit holds the load.

recon_reveal_artifact.label: R-SA-13 main / reveal artifact in twin (E2LT-3)
recon_reveal_artifact.description: Reveal artifact in the GPR twin (E2LT-3): a ReCon reveal untaint enabled by a Stage-2 committed load pair / alias on

a_uv1_invisispec.label: UV1
a_uv1_invisispec.description: A-UV1 (InvisiSpec): a speculative load evicts a live L1D line. Internal label `UV1`.

a_uv1_transient.label: UV1_transient
a_uv1_transient.description: UV1_transient (InvisiSpec): an A-UV1 eviction whose evicting load never became visible (a squashed load).

a_uv4_cleanupspec_split.label: UV4
a_uv4_cleanupspec_split.description: A-UV4 (CleanupSpec): a line-crossing (split) squashed access is not cleaned. Internal labels `UV4_split` / `UV4`.

cs1_older_store_upgrade.label: CS1
cs1_older_store_upgrade.description: CS1 (CleanupSpec): an older committed store upgrades a squashed load's E line to M, so its cleanup is skipped.

cs_em_upgrade.label: EM_upgrade
cs_em_upgrade.description: EM_upgrade (CleanupSpec): a squashed store / RMW upgrades a squashed load's E line to M, so its cleanup is skipped.

a_uv5_cleanupspec_overclean.label: UV5
a_uv5_cleanupspec_overclean.description: A-UV5 (CleanupSpec): cleanup invalidates a line that an older committed access used. Internal `UV5_older_load` / `UV5`.

a_uv3_cleanupspec_rmw.label: UV3
a_uv3_cleanupspec_rmw.description: A-UV3 (CleanupSpec): a speculative read-modify-write's line is not cleaned. Internal label `UV3`.

cs_uv3_other_actor.label: UV3_other_actor
cs_uv3_other_actor.description: UV3_other_actor (CleanupSpec): the A-UV3 event chain, but by an actor that is neither the test's RMW transmitter nor

cs_em_rmw.label: EM_rmw
cs_em_rmw.description: EM_rmw / CS-EM (CleanupSpec): the E->M skip (cs_em_upgrade) caused by the test's OWN RMW transmitter.

cs_em_other.label: EM_other
cs_em_other.description: EM_other (CleanupSpec): the E->M skip (cs_em_upgrade) by an upgrader that is neither the test's RMW nor the padding.

a_uv6_speclfb_first_load.label: UV6
a_uv6_speclfb_first_load.description: A-UV6 (SpecLFB): the first speculative load of a window is left unprotected. Internal tag `uv6_first`, label `UV6`.

uv5_speclfb_jmp_shadow.label: jmp_shadow
uv5_speclfb_jmp_shadow.description: UV5 (SpecLFB): the shadow of a direct jmp / call erases an older branch's shadow. Internal tag `jmp_shadow`.

uv4_speclfb_walk_order.label: walk_order
uv4_speclfb_walk_order.description: UV4 (SpecLFB): ROB walk order unprotects later loads. Internal tag `walk_order`.

uv1_stt_xmm4.label: S1_xmm4
uv1_stt_xmm4.description: UV1 (STT): STT fails to taint one register (FP index 16 = low half of xmm4). Internal label `S1_xmm4`.

uv2_recon_stlf.label: A2 STLF bypass
uv2_recon_stlf.description: UV2 (ReCon): store-to-load forwarding skips the taint check. Internal label A2, `recon_SLF_stlf_bypass`.

uv3_recon_oldest_taint.label: R-SA-8 candidate (br_x twin hit; E2LT-2)
uv3_recon_oldest_taint.description: UV3 (ReCon): only the oldest taint source is kept. Internal label R-SA-8 (candidate), OTB / getOldestTaint.

r_sa13_recon_sse_load.description: R-SA-13 (ReCon): the transmitter's taint is lost through an SSE load producer (FP routing). Labels below.

r_sa9_recon_twin_untaint.description: R-SA-9 (ReCon, in the GPR twin): a twin-hit ld whose main-run transmitter was untainted, and the twin rerun shows no

uv6_vp_squash_race.label: stt_vp_squash_race
uv6_vp_squash_race.description: UV6 (STT, SPT-Fence): the visibility-point / squash race. Internal `stt_vp_squash_race`, `vp_squash_race`.

_doc_bug_scripts: 2026-11-15 (agent bugscripts): every category whose `diag` starts with STAGE3_gem5/bugs/ is one cause module of the bug-script package (one Python module per known cause; orchestrator STAGE3_gem5/bugs/classify.py, docs wiki/findings/bug/BUGS.md 'Bug scripts'). Entries are generated from each module's metadata (LABEL, PAPER_LABEL, ALIASES, DEFENSES, PHASE, VERDICT, ORDER, NEEDS_GEM5, FAMILY) and its docstring's first line. `label` is the exact label classify.py writes. The older per-run entries above (diag_*.py in results/<run>/diagnostics/) stay for the dashboard's per-run buckets; where one names the same cause, it carries `superseded_by`.
